text: しんこきゅう　して　みて　くうきが　おいしいよ！

structure.jp: しんこきゅう　して　みて
くうきが　おいしいよ！

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means to try doing it and see what happens. して　みて = 'try doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: Ending a sentence on the て-form is a casual way to ask someone to do something, like てください with the ください left off. みて = 'please try'.
